indicator_name: Non-oil GDP, oil-gas sector share, non-oil budget balance to non-oil GDP and fiscal impulse (computed by this repository)
description: Ненефтяной ВВП, доля нефтегазового сектора, ненефтяной баланс бюджета к ненефтяному ВВП и фискальный импульс (расчёт репозитория)
unit: bn KZT, % of GDP, % of non-oil GDP, percentage points
methodology: GDP: sum of the four quarters of QNA_GDP_EXPENDITURE (complete years only); oil-gas sector: OIL_GAS_SECTOR_GVA item OIL_GAS (BNS, gross value added, from 2010); non-oil balance: STATE_NON_OIL_DEFICIT (Minfin, state budget, negative = deficit, from 2013); overall balance: STATE_BUDGET_DEFICIT. Fiscal impulse = minus the change in the non-oil balance ratio (positive = expansion). Not cyclically adjusted and not primary; state budget, not general government.
